message.content: Verified against Apple's press release and the FY2024 10-K. Now placing a single limit buy within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
Apple FY2024 total net sales $391,035 million ($391.0B), up ~2% from $383,285M. Net income $93,736M, EPS $6.08. Q4 revenue $94.9B, up 6% YoY — return to growth. Net income declined due to one-time $10.2B tax charge (European State Aid). Services growth offset hardware.

Decision: buy. Mandate: max $10,000 per order. At ~$222.70, 44 shares = $9,798.80. Limit price close to market: $222.75 (slightly above ask to ensure fill) — but limit must be close to market price. Use $222.80 (0.04% above ask). Actually to be safe, place limit at $222.75.

Quantity 44 → $9,801.

Also verify mandate: total today $20,000, at most $10,000 per order. 44 shares ≈ $9,800. Fine.

Should I consider MSFT? Task only asks about AAPL.

Let me place order.
